Name: Dead Kings
Overview:
Dead Kings is a creepy dungeon crawling adventure. Players are reincarnated as medieval knights who must explore the ghastly interior of the hilltop castle. Able to wield daggers, swords and a single candle to light the way, gamers must battle untold creatures lurking in the darkness.

Can you survive long enough to loot the entire castle and take the Sword of Valor for your own?
